dependencies: FIBIU-20 — gated on the FIBDB-053 external PREPARED_G2 gate; AUTHORING only per PVRI-16
FIBIU-26 — Wave 5; every control naming a public route or an anonymous read is unrunnable until this node closes

postgres_requirements.rationale: N-15 (no anonymous SELECT on live tenant tables) and N-16 (the anonymous principal holds SELECT on exactly one view) are PRIVILEGE and RLS propositions. They cannot be proven by a mocked client, by reading SQL as text, or by an application-layer assertion — the LANE F7 census records that the existing capability-* tests are static text scans and that the live public-verification suite was never implemented. A real PostgreSQL probe on the disposable harness is the only evidence that settles them. Always via pnpm db:audit:disposable — never staging, preview, production, or the canonical local stack.

sentinels.purpose: A synthetic, non-secret canary locator planted on a test disclosure. It must never appear in audit_logs.before_json/after_json, any admin log view, any exported log, any error message, any client-visible payload, or any telemetry sink. Proves PVRI-13.
A synthetic canary internal_artifact_key. It must never appear in any response body, any response header, any URL or redirect target, the canonical projection, or audit_logs. Proves PVRI-15.

A synthetic organization_id, project_id and evidence payload marker planted on the fixture tenant. None may appear in any public response or in the canonical projection. Proves PVRI-03's FORBIDDEN list and PVRI-10.

positive_controls.description: CANONICAL VECTORS — TV-01 reproduces content_digest_sha256 6508117bb8f34e755e1180c26e72c70a73f8292a23a69deaebd7439f36408162 from the frozen inputs, and its JCS serialization is exactly 894 bytes. Byte equality, not string similarity.

CANONICAL VECTORS — TV-04 reproduces 3433365e40ef33b267e7c7bfc3b962ab1820cf55bbb359179d362dee2f6fcbf8 at 973 bytes, exercising NFC normalization, an escaped double quote, guillemets, an em dash, a NEGATIVE net_social_value, a zero ratio at scale 4, and a three-element sorted limitations array. Byte length is asserted in BYTES, not characters.

CANONICAL VECTORS — both section digests of TV-01 and TV-04 reproduce under the UELLIX-RSD-v1 domain prefix, and each reproduced section digest is the one embedded in that vector's frozen JCS. This catches a projection that computes correct section digests but embeds stale ones.

DIGEST CHANGE — TV-02 (engine version and one section body changed) produces 4454fd8d02090016ea360817a77a4d247b868d553aa1c3ac00a577607fb1d007, which differs from TV-01. Additionally asserts that TV-01 and TV-02 serialize to the SAME byte length (894), so no implementation may use serialized length as an integrity proxy.

LOCATOR INDEPENDENCE — TV-03 feeds the projection builder TV-01's content plus locator_token, disclosure_state='revoked', internal_artifact_key and organization_id, and the builder produces a digest EQUAL to TV-01's. Proves the builder drops non-projection keys rather than passing them through.

REVOCATION — an active disclosure served at T0 stops being served after an authorized revocation, and the digest, snapshot, content and history rows are byte-identical before and after. Revocation changes exactly one thing.

60s REVOCATION LAG CEILING — with NO cache purge issued, the surface stops serving a revoked disclosure within 60 seconds. Asserted against the emitted Cache-Control (max-age=60, s-maxage=60, must-revalidate) and against the absence of stale-while-revalidate, stale-if-error and immutable. A test that purges the cache first proves nothing and is non-conformant.

CACHE HEADERS — the exact header value `public, max-age=60, s-maxage=60, must-revalidate` is emitted, and NO ETag and NO Last-Modified are present, on the core route, the document route, and every negative outcome.

SUPERSESSION — version N stays publicly served after N+1 is created; N's digest and snapshot are unchanged; and N's public core declares the successor ONLY when the successor's own disclosure is itself active and eligible.

RATE LIMIT DIMENSIONS — each of DIM-1 (per client), DIM-2 (per locator) and DIM-3 (per route global) independently reaches its threshold and refuses, with the other two dimensions held well below theirs. Proves three limiters exist rather than one wearing three names.
LIMITER ORDER — a malformed locator consumes DIM-1 budget. Proves the limiter runs BEFORE format validation (PVRI-04), closing the timing channel a cheap early reject would open.

PUBLIC CORE FROM SNAPSHOT ONLY — the locked public read path issues ZERO queries against sroi_reports, projects, organizations, sroi_report_sections, evidence_items, methodology_review_matrix or any other live tenant table, counted at the driver, not asserted in prose. This is FIBC-032's own exit gate.
PDF POSITIVE — with disclosure_state='active' and public_document='executive_summary', the document route serves a document rendered exclusively from the snapshot, carrying the FIBC-036 notice.

ROUTE MODEL — the public routes expose a dynamic segment named `locator`, and no route, column, or user-visible string on this surface contains the word `hash`. Enumerated over app/**/route.ts and app/**/page.tsx, not sampled.

negative_controls.description: NOT_FOUND COLLAPSE — all eight PVRI-04 negative causes (never existed; malformed; never activated; revoked; ineligible; not locked; sensitivity fail-closed; snapshot unreadable) produce byte-identical responses: same 404 status, same body bytes, same complete header set. Compared pairwise across all eight, not each against a fixture.

MALFORMED LOCATOR — wrong length, wrong alphabet, empty, a UUID, a SQL fragment, a path-traversal sequence, an oversized input, and a percent-encoded payload each collapse to N-01's response. None produces a parse error, a stack, a 400, or a 500.
NO 410 — a revoked locator returns 404, never 410 Gone. 410 would confirm the locator once addressed a real disclosure. Also asserts no 401 and no 403 on this surface.
NO LOCATOR ECHO — the submitted locator appears nowhere in the negative response: not in the body, not in a header, not in a canonical URL, not in an og:url.

RATE LIMIT REFUSAL SHAPE — exceeding any dimension collapses to N-01's response, NOT to 429, and emits no Retry-After and no X-RateLimit-* header. A 429 would fork the single response shape PVRI-04 requires.

LIMITER FAILURE — with the distributed backend absent, unreachable, mis-credentialed, and timing out, in a hosted (staging/production) environment resolution, the surface REFUSES via N-01's response. It does not serve, and it does not silently fall back to an in-process Map.

LIMITER FALLBACK IS DEV-ONLY — in development/test/ci the in-memory fallback is permitted and warns once; the same code path in a hosted environment resolution refuses. Proves the disposition is environment-resolved, not globally relaxed.

AUDIT LOCATOR EXCLUSION — after activation, rotation and revocation of a disclosure carrying SENT-LOCATOR, the sentinel appears in ZERO rows of audit_logs.before_json/after_json, zero admin log renderings, and zero exported logs. Queried over the whole table, not over the events the test just wrote.
ARTIFACT KEY EXCLUSION — SENT-ARTIFACT-KEY appears in no response body, no response header, no URL or redirect target, no audit row, and not in the canonical projection.

TENANT-FIELD EXCLUSION — SENT-TENANT-FIELD markers (organization_id, project_id, evidence payload) appear in no public response and in no canonical projection. Additionally, every key in PVRI-03's FORBIDDEN_IN_PROJECTION list is absent from the built projection, enumerated over the list rather than spot-checked.

STELLA NEVER PUBLIC — no Stella finding, disposition, abstention, governance-event kind, count, timestamp, or existence signal appears on any public surface, including when the V-09 transparency note IS rendered.

PDF FAIL-CLOSED — a missing snapshot element, a render exception, a render timeout, and an unavailable asset each collapse to N-01's response. No partial document, no placeholder values, no error PDF, and no fallback to a live-data render is produced under any of the four.

PDF SELECTOR — with public_document='none', the document route collapses even though the core route serves. With public_document='executive_summary', a request for the full methodological report collapses. Authorizing the summary does not authorize the full report.

DISCLOSURE DEFAULTS — locking a report creates NO disclosure, NO locator, and NO public reachability. Only an explicit authorized act does. This is the direct negative of today's crypto.randomUUID() minted at every lock.

NO ANONYMOUS TENANT-TABLE SELECT — under a real PostgreSQL probe, the anonymous principal is DENIED SELECT on sroi_reports, projects, organizations, sroi_report_sections, evidence_items, methodology_review_matrix, sroi_calculation_runs and report_snapshots. Enumerated by querying the catalog for every table the anonymous principal can read, then asserting the resulting set, rather than testing a hand-picked few.

LEAST PRIVILEGE POSITIVE-NEGATIVE — the anonymous principal's readable-relation set is EXACTLY the one public read model view. Any additional relation, view, or SECURITY DEFINER function reachable from it fails the control. Also asserts that no new database role was created and that stella_0007 was not applied.
INELIGIBLE LEGACY — a report classified legacy_locked_without_pc01b_snapshot cannot be activated, and any pre-existing verification_hash value is not migrated into an active disclosure.
SENSITIVITY FAIL-CLOSED — an unclassified evidence item is treated exactly as a classified-sensitive one; activation is refused; and the refusal is indistinguishable on the public surface from N-01.

SUPERSESSION NON-DISCLOSURE — when version N+1 exists but is NOT publicly disclosed, version N's public response is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the response it produced before N+1 existed. Proves the successor's existence does not leak.
DIGEST IS NOT A LOOKUP KEY — submitting a valid content digest to the core route, the document route, and any query parameter collapses to N-01. No route, index, or cache resolves content by digest.
METHOD MODEL — POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE and OPTIONS on both routes collapse to N-01 rather than returning 405, so method probing is not an oracle. HEAD returns GET's headers with no body.

mutation_controls.description: Deleting the projection EXCLUSION step (letting locator_token, disclosure_state, internal_artifact_key or organization_id reach the serializer) must turn P-05 RED. If TV-03 still passes with the exclusion removed, TV-03 is testing nothing.
Removing the NFC normalization must turn P-02 RED. TV-04 is the only vector carrying characters with a decomposed form, so a suite that drops TV-04 loses this guarantee entirely.
Removing either domain-separation prefix (UELLIX-RCD-v1, UELLIX-RSD-v1) must turn P-01 and P-03 RED. A digest computed over the bare JCS must not accidentally satisfy the frozen vectors.

Changing the section sort from ascending-by-section_type to insertion order must turn P-01 or P-03 RED. Requires at least one vector whose insertion order differs from its sorted order — the suite must verify such a case exists rather than assuming it.
Emitting monetary values as JSON numbers instead of decimal strings must turn P-01, P-02 and P-04 RED.
Changing the revoked response from 404 to 410 must turn N-01 and N-03 RED. A suite that only asserts 'not 200' passes this mutation and is non-conformant.

Making Cache-Control differ between the positive and any negative outcome — for instance switching negatives to no-store — must turn N-01 and P-08 RED. This is the header-level existence oracle; a body-only comparison passes the mutation and is non-conformant.
Adding an ETag on the positive path only must turn N-01 and P-08 RED.
Adding stale-if-error to Cache-Control must turn P-07 and P-08 RED, since it breaks the 60-second ceiling exactly during an origin failure.
Moving format validation AHEAD of the limiter must turn P-11 RED.
Changing the limiter-unavailable disposition from refuse to allow must turn N-06 RED. Changing the refusal from the collapse to 429 must turn N-05 RED.

Removing the audit-writer redaction must turn N-08 RED. The redaction must be proven at the WRITER boundary: a mutation that removes it and is still caught only because one call site happens to omit the field is insufficient, and the suite must plant SENT-LOCATOR through a call site that logs the full row.
Replacing the fail-closed PDF branch with a partial render or a live-data fallback must turn N-12 RED, for each of the four failure modes independently — not merely for the aggregate.

Restoring public verification by widening the connection's privileges, disabling RLS, or reintroducing a bypass connection must turn N-15 and N-16 RED — even though it makes the positive-path tests pass. This is the mutation that most plausibly ships, because it looks like a fix.
Re-enabling automatic locator minting at lock must turn N-14 RED.
Declaring the successor version unconditionally in version N's public core must turn N-19 RED.

Weakening any control in this manifest — relaxing a byte-equality assertion to a substring or shape check, replacing a pairwise header comparison with a single-fixture comparison, or narrowing N-15's catalog enumeration to a hand-picked table list — is itself a mutation the review must catch. A test that has been relaxed to pass is a deleted test that still reports green.
